name: Schlicker Alm
beschreibung:
History

The house rules on schlickeralm-stubai.at write that the Schlickeralm has been a destination for hikers and skiers from Tirol and the whole world since the 1950s and has been developed further over the decades. An exact year of opening is not given by the page. The host, according to the same page, is Bianca with the Schlickeralm team. The address is Schlick 1, 6165 Telfes, telephone +43 5225 62530, mobile +43 664 3540349, email info@schlickeralm-stubai.at. The Stubai tourist board also lists the hut under Schlick 1, 6165 Telfes im Stubaital, and in the page title with 1643 metres. The alpine-pasture page itself names the sun terrace at 1616 metres above sea level. The two altitude figures remain side by side. The domain schlickeralm.at, on retrieval, does not deliver alpine-pasture text, but a general article on alpine skiing with a reference to a casino page. It is not the website of this hut. An older Alpenverein statement with the email schlickeralm@fulpmes.at and the telephone number +43 5225 62409 is not confirmed by the current alpine-pasture website and is not used here as a current contact. The place in the data set was Fulpmes; the alpine-pasture website and Stubai tourism name Telfes.

Getting there

According to its own statement the alpine pasture lies in the middle of the ski and hiking area Schlick 2000, in the protected quiet area of the Schlicker Kalkkögel. The first mountain ride of the Schlick 2000 gondola is at 8:30, the lift installations close at 16:00, the last descent from the middle station is at 16:30. The ski pass is available at the valley station. A free shuttle service with luggage collects overnight guests at the car park of Schlick 2000 and brings them back there on departure. Further journeys go through reception. The nearest cash machine, according to the house rules, is at the HP-Sports shop at the car park of Schlick 2000 in the valley. The Stubaital-Apotheke Fulpmes, telephone +43 5225 62070, is open according to the house rules Monday to Friday 8:00 to 12:00 and 14:30 to 18:30 and Saturday 8:30 to 12:00. As doctor, the Praxisgemeinschaft Dr. Somavilla, Riehlstraße 32a, 6166 Fulpmes, telephone +43 5225 62257, is named.

Tips

In winter the alpine pasture is a meeting point for skiers, ski tourers and winter hikers, in summer for hikers and mountain bikers. Room categories on the room page: double room Standard, Premium and Deluxe, family room and bunk-bed room. The house rules govern the stay. Breakfast buffet from 8:00 to 9:30. The evening menu is laid out in the morning on the breakfast table, with two main courses, dinner between 18:00 and 19:00. Allergies and vegetarian cuisine should be reported on the day of arrival. A vegan menu is not offered. Reception 8:30 to 11:00 and 16:00 to 17:30, otherwise the restaurant team. Main entrance closed from 22:00 to 7:00; the room key opens the terrace entrance. Quiet hours from 22:00. Non-smoking house, ashtrays only outside and on balconies. A false alarm caused by smoking in the room can, according to the house rules, cost about 500 euros. Loss of a key 150 euros. Dogs welcome, 15 euros per night without food, lead required, droppings to the bin below the alpine pasture. Wi-Fi in the rooms free of charge. Children’s and baby beds available, children’s playroom, board games at the bar against a 5 euro deposit. Housekeeping from 10:00. Ski equipment only in the ski room with a night-time drying system, not in the room. The rental partner HP-Sports gives overnight guests 15 percent discount. Lost property is kept for one year. Emergency numbers on the page: rescue 144, police 133, fire brigade 122, mountain rescue 140, doctors’ emergency service 141, European emergency number 112.
kurzbeschreibung: Schlickeralm in the ski area Schlick 2000, Schlick 1, 6165 Telfes, with rooms, restaurant and a sun terrace at 1616 metres. The domain schlickeralm.at does not belong to this alpine pasture.
